mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_profiles (user_id, birth_date, gender, height_cm, weight_kg) VALUES (#{userId}, NULLIF(#{birthday}, ''), NULLIF(#{gender}, ''), #{heightCm}, #{weightKg}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE birth_date = COALESCE(VALUES(birth_date), birth_date), gender = COALESCE(VALUES(gender), gender), height_cm = COALESCE(VALUES(height_cm), height_cm), weight_kg = COALESCE(VALUES(weight_kg), weight_kg)
